objectives.text: Apply destructuring, spread syntax, arrow functions and array map and filter as they appear in React code
Trace an async function that awaits fetch, including where a rejected promise or a non-2xx response is handled
Use ES module import and export, both default and named, correctly

minutes.basis: Measured on the authored artifact.html with the frozen estimator (authoring/tools/timing/estimate_reading.py): P50 8.21 minutes. Worst required path models one additional wrong graded attempt per interactive unit before it settles, at the estimator cost table (1 predict at 30 s, 5 terminal_step at 35 s, 1 explore at 20 s, 1 mcq at 45 s): 12.71 minutes. Budget and about label are 13: the larger of the intake plan of 10 and ceil(max(P50, worst path)), under the 15-minute ceiling (authoring/docs/tools/validators.md). This is a model, not a measurement with learners.
